messages:
Sam (AE): FYI — Arcadia is asking for a 3mo pilot on Dedicated with a bespoke 35% off our hosted rate. Need deal desk + legal review. Can we decide by EOD Fri?
Priya (RevOps): quick Q — what’s projected consumption during pilot (tokens / embeddings) and any convert-to-commit signal?
Sam (AE): Expect ~2M gen tokens/month, ~120k embeddings/month. They want 50 rps sustained, low latency. Strong chance to convert to annual if pilot meets latency/SLOs.
pricing-bot: ratecard v2 -> <https://redwood.internal/ratecard/v2|redwood-rate-card v2> (gen token = $0.004/1k, embedding = $0.02/1k)
Marco (Eng): Technical note — 50 rps with KV caching and 8GB KV footprint per active session. Dedicated pool of 4xA100 would cover latency target. Back-of-envelope infra cost @ list = ~$70k/mo.
Eli (Deal Desk): 35% off on list pushes monthly revenue to ~$45.5k/mo against $70k infra. Need margin calc and conversion ask. Who’s sponsoring the conversion guarantee?
Sam (AE): Customer told us they’d convert to a 12mo commit if SLA holds, but non-binding. They can commit to a conversion conversation within 30 days post-pilot.
Jade (Legal): Also need to know SOC2 status and if they require custom indemnities/data residency. We won’t accept open-ended indemnity; SCCs/KMS ok.
Priya (RevOps): Action: Sam, please create a finance ticket with expected ARR uplift on conversion and requested concession (35%). We need to run sensitivity: 3mo pilot -> conversion rate scenarios.
Sam (AE): Will do. Suggestion: offer conditional structure — 35% off for 3mo pilot if they sign a conversion LOI within 45 days; otherwise 20% fallback. No changes to T&Cs, standard DPAs + SCCs.
Eli (Deal Desk): Counter-proposal: approve up to 30% off if they commit to a 12mo $350k ARR within 45 days, OR 35% off limited to hosted (not private/on-prem) and capped at $200k total concession. Need final sign-off from Finance for anything >$150k concession.
Marco (Eng): Also flag: Dedicated for pilot has capacity lead time ~2 weeks. If they want fast start, we can run on hosted with dedicated QoS instead — cheaper and quicker.
Jade (Legal): We need their completed security questionnaire before we spin dedicated hardware. SOC2 in progress is ok but must provide expected completion date. No custom SLA changes.
Priya (RevOps): I’ll model the two scenarios (30% with commit vs 35% conditional LOI). Will post P&L.
Sam (AE): Thanks — leaning to Eli’s counter. If Finance ok, I’ll present: 35% conditional (LOI 45d) limited to hosted; or 30% guaranteed with signed 12mo $350k ARR.
Eli (Deal Desk): Sounds good. @Priya please flag if concession >$150k and @Jade loop legal on the LOI wording. If Finance gives green, I’ll approve and route to CRO for final sign. :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): Will update with finance numbers by tomorrow morning and attach the LOI draft.
Priya (RevOps): noted.
Marco (Eng): tagging capacity ops to prep a 2-week provisioning path if we go dedicated.
Sam (AE): Appreciate everyone — will follow up with ticket + LOI.
